headline: Emotional Intelligence, from entry to detail
overview: Answer 60 questions to score on 15 EQ subscales across 5 composites: Self-Perception, Self-Expression, Interpersonal, Decision Making, and Stress Management.

keyFeatures: 60-question assessment measuring emotional intelligence across 5 composite areas
Scores on 15 EQ subscales including self-regard, empathy, assertiveness, impulse control, and stress tolerance
Based on the Bar-On EQ-i model, one of the most widely used EQ frameworks in research and organizations
Pinpoints specific EQ strengths and development areas across emotional and social functioning
tips: EQ is more malleable than IQ — use your subscale scores to identify one or two specific areas for focused development rather than trying to improve everything at once.
Answer based on how you typically feel and behave, not your ideal self — accurate self-awareness is itself a key component of emotional intelligence.
